data.name: Masheedi
data.long_meaning: One who is constantly in search of knowledge and guidance from Allah. The name Masheedi is derived from the Arabic word ‘masaha’ which means ‘to seek’ or ‘to ask’. This name is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and guidance from Allah and striving to live a righteous and obedient life.

Masheedis are natural born leaders and are often drawn to the arts, sciences, or teaching.
